task: Repair this 45–70-word passage and note 7 in a Chicago 18 history essay. The minutes were fully cited in note 2, and note 6 cites a different work. The venue requires a shortened note here, not ibid.: Plover Basin Makers Council, “Minutes of the September 6 Meeting,” sec. 4. The PDF has numbered sections but no pages. Retain note number 7, correct the status of the motion, and do not add a bibliography or invent an archive, page number, or later vote.
input:
The council approved moving the kiln, and work therefore began that month. The unanimous decision appears on page 8 of the meeting record.⁷

7. Ibid., 8.

facts.text: Source record: Plover Basin Makers Council; Minutes of the September 6 Meeting; September 6, 2024; https://example.org/plover-basin/minutes-2024-09-06.
Section 4 records a motion to move the kiln, which the chair deferred before a vote.
The supplied minutes contain no approval, vote count, or record that moving work began.
The document has numbered sections, no page numbers, and was fully cited in note 2; intervening note 6 cites another source.

forbidden_additions: An approval, unanimous vote, construction start, or later decision
A page 8 locator or an invented archive
An ibid. reference that points to the intervening different work
preserve: Plover Basin Makers Council, “Minutes of the September 6 Meeting,” sec. 4
A proposed move was deferred before a vote
